test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between D and F when counted from the left of F. E sits third to the left of G. A sits to the immediate right of G. A sits second to the left of D. B is an immediate neighbour of E. How many people sit between C and F when counted from the left of C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only two people sit between D and F when counted from the left of F.

2) A sits second to the left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94aba44ba7ba0346e0a1b42127e81ff6412f34e1e2372dc68a2f2aba39f3675a.png] 

3) E sits third to the left of G.

4) B is an immediate neighbour of E. 

After positioning B, G and E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cae682b599d7351aad0bc41ee5c31d9450e4c8a32e0c9736ac75319562774a88.png] 

Thus, two people sit between C and F when counted from the left of C.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
